description: This file implements cache management routines for a specific CPU (PPC MPC55xx) within an AUTOSAR-based system. It includes functions for invalidating and enabling the cache, and references hardware-specific registers and macros.

methods.name: void Cache_Invalidate(void)
methods.description: Invalidates the CPU's cache by setting the appropriate control register after waiting for active invalidation to complete.

methods.name: void Cache_EnableU(void)
methods.description: Enables the cache and ensures it is invalidated beforehand. Specific to MPC5668.

methods.name: void Cache_EnableD(void)
methods.description: Stub function intended to enable the data cache (currently empty).

methods.name: void Cache_EnableI(void)
methods.description: Stub function intended to enable the instruction cache (currently empty).
